never_forward: An adapter may NEVER forward credentials, raw tool-permission grants, hook configuration, or absolute paths into credential stores.
role: ARC-0041 claim-under-test extract; ARC-0038 still owns DESIGN.json
sanitize_where: Sanitization is on the vendor RETURN path after last-message parse and before any Claude-side agent reads parsed; it is not the inbound prompt-file transport.
silent_unobservability: If parsed is forwarded unsanitized, a role-spoof or instruction-override in a second-vendor last-message is silently treated as instructions.
trust_boundary: A second vendor's output is untrusted DATA and a prompt-injection carrier, never instructions; Claude-side agents may read it only after the A6 quarantine envelope is applied.
wrong_locus_sentence: Sanitization happens at the prompt-file transport because the prompt body never appears on argv.
